CustomField.description: Lifecycle state of the NDA. THE MASTER SET IS THE UNION OF TWO RECORD-TYPE SETS AND NO SINGLE RECORD TYPE SEES ALL SIX. Acquisition_NDA exposes Pending, Sent, Received, Signed (D14.1). Disposition_NDA exposes Not Sent, Sent, Signed, Declined (Part 2 lines 28-41). Sent and Signed are SHARED, so this field alone does NOT identify the record type - use Disposition__c or RecordTypeId for that. Three values were ADDED 2026-08-09 (Received, Not Sent, Declined) and ZERO were removed, so every existing acquisition NDA keeps a valid value and no data migration is needed. Read by the NDA_Signed_Status_Sync before-save flow, which derives NDA_Signed__c, and by the NDA_Signed_Rollup after-save flow, which counts Signed rows onto the parent Disposition.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Pick the state this NDA is in. The choices differ by record type: an acquisition NDA runs Pending, Sent, Received, Signed; a disposition NDA runs Not Sent, Sent, Signed, and Declined if the counterparty refuses.
CustomField.label: Status
